metaDescription: Firestone designs, installs and maintains fire suppression systems in the UAE, including FM200, Novec 1230, kitchen hood and clean agent systems.

blocks.text: When a fire breaks out in high-risk environments, a fast-acting fire suppression system can mean the difference between a minor incident and a catastrophic loss. We design, install, and maintain fire suppression systems across the UAE — including FM200, Novec 1230, CO2, kitchen hood, and clean agent systems — engineered and commissioned to protect critical assets like data centers, server rooms, industrial facilities, and commercial kitchens.
